fortunes.text: A candle you light for someone else burns your own shadow first.
The creak you heard was the house, not the thing inside it.
You will find something in a coat pocket that isn't yours.
Someone is telling a story about you. They've made you the villain.
The path home will look shorter than it is tonight.
A door you've always walked past was not always closed.
You left something important somewhere. It hasn't moved.
The mirror you avoid has been watching longer than you think.
Tonight the dark is ordinary. Tomorrow something changes.
You will be remembered fondly. And inaccurately.
The thing you're afraid of has already happened. You survived it.
Your luck is fine. Your judgment is the problem.
Someone is thinking of you. It is not a kind thought. Bring garlic.
You will inherit something this season. It will not be money.
The pumpkin you carved will remember your face.
Do not answer the third knock.
A small kindness returns to you tonight, wearing a mask.
Something lost comes back before sunrise. Do not look at it directly.
Trust the one who offers to carry it. Refuse the one who insists.
You are being followed by an admirer. So is everyone else.
The recipe you follow tonight will change the way you see the kitchen forever.
You are preparing for the wrong thing. The real test looks nothing like this.
A stranger's laugh will be the last sound you remember from a place you're about to leave.
The scar you're ashamed of will become someone else's comfort.
You've been reading the wrong signs. Turn the map upside down.
Someone close to you is haunted by a version of you that doesn't exist anymore.
The mask you wear for protection is becoming your face.
You will be offered a choice between being right and being free. Choose carefully.
The thing that scares you most is a door someone else is holding open.
You keep waiting for permission to change. It isn't coming. Change anyway.
A conversation you avoid will become the one you replay for years.
The house you're afraid of was once someone's home. They miss it too.
You will outlive someone who deserves more time than you. Make it matter.
The person you admire most has the exact flaw you refuse to see in yourself.
You will be given a second chance. It will not look like the first.
The love you're waiting for is already here. You keep looking past it.
One night you'll wish you'd said yes. The night is closer than you think.
You are haunted not by the dead, but by the living versions of yourself you've abandoned.
The silence you're guarding will be the thing you regret most. Speak before the door closes for the last time.
You will meet someone who reminds you of who you were before the world taught you to flinch. Do not waste it being careful.
Something you buried will resurface, and it will ask for its name back.
The ending you fear is actually the beginning of the story you've been begging the universe for.
Your reflection blinked. That's not your problem tonight.
A black cat will cross your path. Follow it this time.
You'll hear your name called in an empty room. It's the only honest listener you have.
Tonight is a good night to burn something you've been carrying. Not literally. Probably.
The ghost that haunts you most is the version of yourself you keep apologizing for.
You are braver than the thing under the bed, and the thing under the bed knows it.
Someone you've forgotten will reappear and change the direction of your year. You won't recognize them at first.
The darkness you fear is not empty. It's full of every version of you that survived. They're waiting. And they're proud.
